news.title: UNI students win Gold national advertising award
news.summary_en: A group of UNI students came home with the competition’s highest honors at the National American Advertising Awards, the advertising industry’s largest competition, which attracts more than 25,000 entries each year from both industry professionals and students.

news.title: UNI athletic training student becomes life-saving donor for leukemia patient
news.summary_en: UNI Master of Athletic Training student Max Mullis traveled to Chicago to donate stem cells to a 73-year-old leukemia patient.

news.title: How Curris became the heart of business at UNI
news.summary_en: For 35 years, the Curris Business Building has been the heart of business at UNI. Now, the spaces that shaped generations of students are helping define the future of business education.

news.title: Brewing community for generations of Panthers
news.summary_en: Even before the "Wherever You Go, UNI" sign was placed on the side of her coffee shop, Dawn Wilson has always been conennected to UNI.

news.title: UNI recognizes students on Spring 2026 graduation and dean’s lists
news.summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa is pleased to celebrate the academic achievements of students named to the spring 2026 graduation and dean’s lists.

news.title: University of Northern Iowa unveils “Wherever You Go, UNI” campaign
news.summary_en: The message is simple: Wherever you go, UNI. It’s the focus of a new statewide campaign highlighting the impact of the University of Northern Iowa across the state and beyond.
